agency: City of San Antonio Development Services Department (DSD)

code_edition.value: 2023 National Electrical Code (as adopted and amended by City of San Antonio Chapter 10)

requirements.item: Exterior service disconnect required by CPS Energy for one- and two-family dwellings
requirements.quote: (Note: CPS Energy requires exterior service disconnect for dwellings).

requirements.item: Submit online registration, One-Line Diagram, Site Layout/Plan, Photos, Equipment Specs, and DER Application to cpsesolar@cpsenergy.com for solar PV
requirements.quote: Step 2: Submit online registration form & preconstruction documentation: One-Line Diagram, Site Layout/Plan and Photos, Equipment Specifications, and the Distributed Energy Resource (DER) Application to cpsesolar@cpsenergy.com.

requirements.item: City DSD inspection approval must be passed and sent to CPS Energy for utility release
requirements.quote: If appropriate inspections are passed, the approval is manually sent to CPS Energy for the release.

open_questions: The exact effective date of City of San Antonio's adoption of the 2023 National Electrical Code could not be confirmed verbatim from the indexed excerpts of https://docsonline.sanantonio.gov/DSDUploads/2024Ch10Building-RelatedCodesFinal.pdf.

Pages 4–6 of Information Bulletin 153 (https://docsonline.sanantonio.gov/FileUploads/dsd/IB153.pdf) were only partially indexed; specific electrical one-line diagram details and residential battery energy storage system (ESS) submittal items could not be fully verified.

No dedicated City of San Antonio single-family residential electrical submittal checklist was found for standalone Level 2 EV chargers, main panel/service upgrades, subpanels, 240 V appliance circuits, or standby/portable generators on sa.gov or docsonline.sanantonio.gov.

No City of San Antonio-published residential electrical load calculation worksheet, mandatory NEC 220 method (220.82 vs. 220.83 vs. 220.87), EV charger service load factor, or minimum plan sheet size was found on sa.gov or docsonline.sanantonio.gov.

plans_required_single_family.program_name: DSD Photovoltaic Permit Application (BuildSA Building Module; technical plan review goal 3 working days)
plans_required_single_family.quote: Once files are uploaded, the City of San Antonio receives notice of the application and checks for completeness of the application and documents prior to the start of technical plan review.

checklist.title: Information Bulletin 153: Requirements for Solar Photovoltaic Systems (PV) (Commercial/Residential)

requirements.item: Online DSD Photovoltaic permit application submitted by a Master Electrician via BuildSA building module
requirements.quote: The master electrician must be the applicant. Others may be added as contacts to the application record. The application is located under the building module tab in the customer portal.

requirements.item: Site Plan showing existing/proposed structures, setbacks to property/lot lines, and main electrical service wall layout
requirements.quote: 1) Site Plan – showing the location of: a) Existing structures on the property. i) Location of any newly proposed structures. ii) Provide set back locations and dimensions to property lines and internal lot lines. b) Main Electrical Service.

requirements.item: Texas-licensed PE structural calculations if roof array >6 lbs/sq ft on <4:12 pitch, >=2 roof coverings, or new support structure
requirements.quote: Single Family, R-3, duplex, and townhome buildings shall require Engineering calculations from an engineer licensed in the State of Texas for roof-mounted array systems where any of the following occur:

requirements.item: CPS Energy preconstruction package: One-Line Diagram, Site Layout/Plan, Photos, Equipment Specs, and DER Application
requirements.quote: Step 2: Submit online registration form & preconstruction documentation: One-Line Diagram, Site Layout/Plan and Photos, Equipment Specifications, and the Distributed Energy Resource (DER) Application to cpsesolar@cpsenergy.com.

sheet_requirements.copies_or_format: Electronic upload via BuildSA Customer Portal
sheet_requirements.signature_or_stamp: Texas-licensed PE stamp required for structural calculations when roof slope <4:12 with >6 lbs/sq ft, >=2 roof coverings, or new structure
sheet_requirements.quote: Any revised file or sheet should contain all the information supplied in the original plus indications of corrections made.

local_rules.rule: Master Electrician must be the primary applicant on the DSD Photovoltaic permit application
local_rules.quote: The master electrician must be the applicant.

local_rules.rule: Rough-in and final solar inspections are typically requested at the same time via BuildSA
local_rules.quote: Typically, the rough-in and final are called at the same time.

local_rules.rule: Systems >=25 kW AC are forwarded to CPS Energy DER Engineering Team for additional review
local_rules.quote: (Note: =>25kW AC systems will be forwarded to DER Engineering Team for review).
